facts.fact: DEA's Office Memorandum 'Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27' is dated 30.09.2026 (dea.gov.in/files/budget_division_documents/R.pdf)
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: The 30.09.2026 OM keeps Q3 FY 2026-27 (1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026) small savings rates unchanged from those notified for Q2
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter
facts.note: DEA OM F.No.1/4/2019-NS dated 30.09.2026, read by OCR of the scanned PDF.

summary: DEA OM dated 30.09.2026 (R.pdf) confirmed; its OCR text says Q3 2026-27 rates remain unchanged from Q2.
